meta.title: Short Notice — The Ballad of Alec
meta.subtitle: NDGF Seasonal Changes • One-stop hunter reminder
meta.note: All live NDGF pull 2026-09-03. Dates from https://gf.nd.gov/hunting/season-dates and proclamations. YoY diff vs 2023-2025 tentative->finalized.

headsUp.title: Fire Danger HIGH — Check Daily
headsUp.body: NDGF + NDResponse: burn restrictions may close PLOTS/WMA. No off-road travel on NDDH fire ban days.

headsUp.title: CWD Testing — Bring the Head
headsUp.body: Carcass or boned meat must be accompanied by head to final storage. OR photo-tag method: pic at kill site + tag closeup (timestamp/location on) → drop head at CWD site. Mandatory for 4A-F, 3B3.

headsUp.title: Nonresident WMA/PLOTS Blackout Oct 10-16
headsUp.body: N.D.C.C. 20.1-08-04.9: nonresidents cannot hunt GF WMAs or PLOTS Oct 10-16, 2026. Exception: PLOTS you own.

categories.label: Deer
categories.blurb: Alec forgot the bow opener. Never again.

species.name: Deer — Bow
species.units: Statewide • Nonres private-only Sep 4-13 (no PLOTS unless owned)
species.resident: Any deer. No unit restriction. Orange required during gun season if afield.
species.nonresident: Restricted to deer type on license. Sep 4-13 private land only (excl. PLOTS). Sep 14+ public allowed. Crossbow by permit only.

briefing.bag: 1 per license. 1 regular bow license/year. Herd-reduction allows +2 antlerless (city zones with access permit).
briefing.gear: Compound/recurve ≥35lb @28". Arrow ≥24", broadhead ≥2 edges, ≥¾" cut. Mech. broadheads legal. Lighted nock OK. Crossbow ≥75lb, 14" bolt, shoulder-fired.
briefing.unchanged: Noon opener, Jan 3 closer, orange rule, 35lb minimum — unchanged since 2023.

yoy3.change: Finalized Mar 25. No date shift vs 2025.
Same Sep 4–Jan 3 window. Herd-reduction zones expanded (Watford City added).
Same framework. Pre-charged pneumatic .35cal/150gr/600fps clarified as legal.

major5: 2025: Watford City deer-bow herd reduction zone added (Fig.5)
2024: Airbow/pneumatic air gun spec finalized (.35cal/150gr/600fps)
2023: Youth muzzy eligibility tightened to antlerless-only for 11-13 in 4A-F without special mule deer tag
REMOVED 2024: telescoping sights ban clarified — 1x scopes now explicitly legal on muzzy, verifiers legal on bow
species.unitNotes: Gun units 4B/4C + 4D/4E must stay in assigned unit first 2.5 days (Nov 6-8) then may swap within pair.

proclamation.highlight: Sec 1: Sep 4 (12 noon) – Jan 3. <mark>Nonresident private-only first 9.5 days</mark>. <mark>Plains air gun: ≥.35cal/150gr/600fps</mark>. Herd reduction → Jan 3 sunset.
proclamation.removed: REMOVED: No general sex change — any-deer still resident bow.
proclamation.added: ADDED: South Bismarck/Mandan MDHRS lab access via ARS permit.

species.trashTalk: Alec's bow is taller than he is — still shoots straight, just needs a lower blind window.

resident: Hunter ed if born after 1961 (or apprentice license + mentor)
Buy bow license online at gf.nd.gov — 1 per year, mailed from Bismarck
Any deer, statewide, no unit — but WMA centerfire-closed still applies if you carry gun
Sep 4 noon opener → Jan 3 close — no hunting before noon day one
Wear orange during gun season even as bow hunter (Nov 6-22)
Tag immediately, keep head/antler or photo-tag method for CWD
nonresident: Nonres bow license online only — choose whitetail vs mule type
Sep 4-13: PRIVATE LAND ONLY (no PLOTS/WMA unless you own that PLOTS)
Sep 14+: public land opens — still orange during gun season
Crossbow only with director permit — don't assume
Same tag + head/photo rule as resident

species.name: Deer — Gun
species.units: All units by lottery • 39,100 licenses incl. gratis (2026)
species.resident: Weighted lottery. Unsuccessful → leftover lottery → first-come. 4B/4C/D/E 2.5-day stay rule.
species.nonresident: Same lottery, same unit/type restriction. No Orange waiver.

briefing.sex: As printed: species (whitetail/mule) + antlered/antlerless. Special antlered mule tags only in 4A-F.
briefing.bag: 1 per license. Concurrent antlerless may run with bow/gun/muzzy if Director declares after lottery.
briefing.gear: Centerfire ≥.22, muzzy ≥.45 (shoulder). Shotgun rifled slug/round ball ≥20ga, 18" barrel. Handgun ≥.35, 4" barrel. FMJ / full-auto prohibited. Air gun same spec as bow.
briefing.unchanged: 16.5-day gun, orange required, concurrent season framework unchanged.

yoy3.change: Nov 8-24. Similar cap. No major restriction change.
Nov 10-26. Centerfire-closed zones clarified (Devils Lake 2L, Bismarck/Mandan buffers).

major5: 2026: License cap 39,100 — down slightly pre-2023; concurrent antlerless TBD post-lottery
REMOVED 2023: Youth concurrent restriction eased — 14-15 with youth license now eligible to hunt youth season
WMA centerfire-closed areas posted at access points — check on-site, not just proclamation
species.unitNotes: Centerfire CLOSED: Devils Lake 2L Camp Grafton sliver, Bismarck/ Mandan river buffers, Drake WMA zones — shotgun/muzzy/bow only there.

proclamation.highlight: Nov 6 noon – Nov 22. <mark>39,100 licenses</mark>. <mark>4B/C/D/E pair stay 2.5 days</mark>. Unit/type as printed.
proclamation.removed: REMOVED: No new statewide antler restriction — check unit-specific antlerless tags.
proclamation.added: ADDED: Confirm concurrent season after lottery — proclamation adds herd-reduction appendix.

species.trashTalk: Alec's orange vest is 90% of his silhouette. Easy to spot, hard to miss.

resident: Apply lottery at gf.nd.gov/lotteries — deadline early June
Weighted lottery: more points if you’ve been skunked before
39,100 tags — if you miss, leftover lottery then first-come
16.5 days: Nov 6 noon – Nov 22 — unit/type as printed, read it twice
4B/4C and 4D/4E: stay in your unit first 2.5 days (Nov 6-8)
Gratis landowner? Apply via Bismarck office, separate from online
nonresident: Same lottery, same deadline — no separate nonres gun pool
If drawn, unit and species (whitetail/mule, antlered/antlerless) is locked
Nonres WMA/PLOTS blackout Oct 10-16 still counts — don't scout then
Need ND hunting cert + habitat stamp — buy before you apply

species.name: Deer — Muzzleloader
species.resident: Weighted lottery, white-tailed + antler type as printed.

briefing.sex: White-tailed only (mule deer not legal muzzy). Antlered/antlerless per license.
briefing.bag: 1 per license. Tag must stay with head/antler or photo method if head dropped at CWD site.
briefing.gear: Flint/percussion, loaded via muzzle, black powder/substitute only (no smokeless). Scope prohibited except 1x (no magnification).
briefing.unchanged: Statewide white-tail only, Dec 13 close, 1x scope exception.

yoy3.change: Smokeless still prohibited; 1x scopes explicitly listed.

major5: REMOVED 2024: ambiguity on verifiers — now legal across bow/muzzy
species.unitNotes: Head of Mountain Preserve 2G2: muzzy/bow only, walk-in, muzzy/bow license required.

proclamation.highlight: <mark>Nov 27 noon – Dec 13. White-tailed only. No smokeless. 1× scope only.</mark>
proclamation.removed: No change to Caliber — ≥.45 long gun, ≥.50 handgun muzzy.

species.trashTalk: Muzzleloader season: Alec finally gets to make extra smoke to hide behind — tactically.

resident: Lottery at gf.nd.gov — white-tailed only, statewide
No smokeless — black powder/sub only. 1x scope only (no magnification)
Nov 27 noon – Dec 13, orange required
Tag same as gun — head or photo method
nonresident: Same lottery, same white-tail only rule
If you own PLOTS, you can use it muzzy season
1x scope only — leave the 3-9x at home

species.name: Deer — Youth (Res. only)
species.resident: 11-13 any antlerless; 14-15 any deer (once-in-a-lifetime any-deer if never drew gun). Special mule-deer tag needed in 4A-F.
species.nonresident: Not eligible — youth deer is resident only.

briefing.sex: 11-13 antlerless only / 14-15 any deer. 4A-F mule deer needs unit-specific tag.
briefing.bag: One youth license counts for youth + gun season (same tag). Adult mentor unaided verbal contact, unarmed, no firearm/bow.
briefing.gear: Same as gun season. Quadriplegic gun license holders may hunt youth season.
briefing.unchanged: Sep 18-27 window, mentor rule, para hunts — unchanged.

yoy3.change: Sep 18-27 finalized, quota tied to gun lottery.
Age cut clarified: 10 turning 11 in year eligible.

major5: REMOVED: no new restriction — youth concurrent eligibility expanded for 14-15
species.unitNotes: 4A-F antlerless mule deer requires special youth mule tag (unit-specific).

proclamation.highlight: <mark>Sep 18 noon – Sep 27. Residents 11-13 antlerless, 14-15 any deer.</mark>
proclamation.removed: REMOVED: No carry for mentor — enforced.

species.trashTalk: Youth season reminder — Alec still gets carded at the license counter. He takes it as a compliment.

resident: Residents 11-15 only — 11-13 antlerless only, 14-15 any deer
Needs hunter ed + adult mentor (unaided voice, unarmed, no bow/gun)
One youth tag covers youth season Sep 18-27 AND gun season — not two tags
4A-F mule deer needs special youth mule tag — unit-specific
nonresident: Youth deer is RESIDENT ONLY — nonres youth cannot apply
Nonres youth can do small game/waterfowl on resident cert if <16 Sep 1 + hunter ed

categories.label: Upland
categories.blurb: Pheasants, sharptail, grouse — where Alec gets winded.

species.name: Ring-necked Pheasant
species.resident: Male only regular; youth Sep 20-21 overlap. PLOTS/WMA blackout Oct 10-16 N/A ( pheasant not deer-only rule).
species.nonresident: Same dates, nonres small-game license. PLOTS access after Oct 14 private-only bow rule not applicable — but check upland posting.

briefing.sex: Males only regular season. Hens protected.
briefing.bag: 3 daily, 12 possession (regular). Check proclamation sidebar for full limits — map varies 2024-26 slightly.
briefing.gear: Shotgun plug 3 shells for migratory? Not required pheasant, but nontoxic not required upland. Blaze orange recommended.
briefing.unchanged: Oct opener, Jan 3 closer, male-only — stable 5yr.

yoy3.change: Oct 10 – Jan 3 finalized. No bag change.

major5: 5yr stable. REMOVED 2023: late-season hen protection clarified — no hen harvest regular season
species.unitNotes: No unit restrictions statewide. Parks (Unit 2L Grahams Island) require park permit.

proclamation.highlight: <mark>Oct 10 – Jan 3. Male pheasants only. Youth Sep 20-21.</mark>
proclamation.removed: No hen season — removed years ago, stays removed.

species.trashTalk: Pheasants love CRP. Alec loves CRP — finally, cover that fits.

resident: Male only — hens are off limits. Count your tail feathers
Oct 10 – Jan 3, statewide, no unit lottery
3 daily / 12 possession — don't be the 'I thought it was 6' guy
Youth Sep 20-21 before regular — take a kid, look like a hero
nonresident: Nonres small game license + habitat — buy before you walk PLOTS
Same male-only, same dates — no nonres restriction on pheasant
PLOTS open but respect posted + call ahead on fire ban days

species.name: Sharp-tailed & Ruffed Grouse / Prairie Chicken
species.units: Sharp-tail statewide; Ruffed NE; Prairie Chicken closed/limited
species.resident: Sharp-tail Sep 12-Jan 3. Sage grouse closed. Prairie chicken by limited lottery if open.
species.nonresident: Same; nonres prairie chicken not lottery-eligible if closed.

briefing.bag: Sharp-tail 3/12, Ruffed 3/12, Huns 3/12 — check daily aggregate. Prairie chicken closed 2026.
briefing.gear: Shotgun only, no rifle. Nontoxic not required upland.
briefing.unchanged: Sep 12 opener, Jan 3 close, sage closed — unchanged.

yoy3.change: Prairie chicken season tentative only, remained closed.

major5: Sage grouse remains closed 5yr. Prairie chicken limited lottery suspended 2024-26
species.unitNotes: Sage grouse closed statewide. Check unit 4 prairie chicken lottery status.
species.trashTalk: Sharp-tails love short grass. Alec loves that he can actually see over it.

resident: Sharp-tail & Huns Sep 12 – Jan 3, statewide
Sage grouse CLOSED 5yrs — don't even think about it
Prairie chicken closed/lottery — check proclamation, not memory
3/12 sharp-tail, ruffed where open — don't mix bags
nonresident: Same seasons, same closures
Prairie chicken lottery resident-leaning — nonres odds low if open

categories.label: Waterfowl
categories.blurb: Ducks, geese, swans — bag limits get spicy. Extra work here.

species.name: Ducks, Coots, Mergansers
species.units: Low Plains / High Plains + Youth & Veteran splits
species.resident: Sep 26-Dec 6 Low, Oct 3-Dec 6 High (check zone). Youth Sep 12-13, Vet Sep 19-20.
species.nonresident: Nonres waterfowl needs nonres waterfowl lic + HIP + federal duck stamp. 14-day or season lic. Zone same.

briefing.sex: Hen mallard ≤2, pintail/scaup within season — see species caps left. Federal framework applies.
briefing.bag: 6 ducks daily (possession 18). Within that: mallard 4 (≤2 hens) • wood duck 3 • scaup 2 • redhead 2 • canvasback 2 • black duck 2 • pintail 1 (2026 framework may allow 3 — verify gf.nd.gov/waterfowl before you go). Coot 15 (45), merganser 5 (≤2 hooded, 15). Scaup may have split 45-day window — check dates.
briefing.gear: Nontoxic shot required. Shotgun plugged to 3 shells. Electronic calls prohibited (except light geese spring).

yoy3.change: Low Plains Sep 26–Dec 6, High Plains Oct 3–Dec 6. Bag stays 6; pintail framework under review (1 vs 3 — verify).
Same 6-duck, scaup 2-bird window extended; HIP online-only.

major5: 2025: Scaup bag split modified (consult matrix)
2024: HIP registration moved online-only
REMOVED 2023: early teal season still closed ND
ADDED: Veteran/Active season Sep 19-20 now permanent
species.unitNotes: Low Plains vs High Plains zone line matters — Missouri River corridor. Check gf.nd.gov/waterfowl map.

proclamation.highlight: <mark>6 ducks daily (45 possession: coot 15/45, merg 5/15). Mallard 4 (2 hens), wood 3, scaup 2, redhead 2</mark> — verify pintail 1 vs 3 at gf.nd.gov/waterfowl. Youth Sep 12-13.
proclamation.removed: REMOVED: No lead shot — nontoxic only stays.

species.trashTalk: Ducks need decoys. Alec brings the calling — the decoys do the looking tall part.

resident: Federal duck stamp + HIP + plugged gun (3 shells) — no excuses
Low Plains Sep 26, High Plains Oct 3 — know your zone line (Missouri River)
6 duck bag but species caps kill you: mallard 5/2 hen, scaup 1-2 split, pintail 1
Youth Sep 12-13, Vet Sep 19-20 — let the kids shoot first
nonresident: Nonres waterfowl lic (14-day or season) + HIP + stamp
Same zones, same bags — 14-day starts when you pick, not Sep 26
Nontoxic shot only — lead = ticket, and Alec will never let you hear the end

species.name: Canada / White-front / Light Geese
species.units: Early Canada Sep 1, Regular Sep 26, Light spring Mar 1
species.resident: Early Canada 15/45, Regular 8/24, White-front 3/9, Light 20/no limit spring.
species.nonresident: Same bags. Light goose spring conservation order Feb 21-May 10 — electronic calls + unplugged allowed.

briefing.bag: Canada early Sep 1: 15 daily (45). Regular: 8 (24). White-front 3 (9). Light 20 (no possession fall) / no limit spring CO Feb 21–May 10. Tundra swan lottery separate.
briefing.gear: Nontoxic, plugged 3 (except spring light geese — unplugged + e-callers legal).
briefing.unchanged: Early/regular split, spring CO rules unchanged.

major5: Spring Light Geese CO Feb 21-May 10 — e-caller + unplugged — stable 5yr
species.unitNotes: Tundra swan by lottery Sep 26-Dec 6 — separate tag.

proclamation.removed: No fall light goose e-caller — still prohibited.

species.trashTalk: Geese fly high. Alec just brings louder calls and a comfier blind chair.

resident: Early Canada Sep 1 (15/45) — then 8/24 regular, White-front 3/9
Light geese Sep 26 – Dec 20 + Spring CO Feb 21-May 10 (no limit, e-callers + unplugged OK)
Tundra swan lottery separate — don't shoot a swan on a goose tag
nonresident: Same bags, same spring CO — spring is your best nonres value
Spring CO: unplugged + e-callers legal — fall? absolutely not

categories.label: Fishing
categories.blurb: Walleye, pike, darkhouse, paddlefish — different proclamation.

species.name: Open Water / Ice Fishing
species.resident: General game + fishing lic. Darkhouse spearing Dec 1-Mar 15 (pike/walleye lakes).
species.nonresident: Nonres fishing lic, 3-day/10-day options. Darkhouse same season, nonres allowed.

briefing.bag: Walleye 5 daily/10 possession (varies by water: Devils Lake, Sakakawea). Pike 5/10, perch varies.
briefing.gear: 2 lines open water, 4 ice (2 w/ tip-up). Barotrauma tool required Sakakawea deep water. ANS drain-plug out.

yoy3.change: No statewide bag change. Lake-specific Sakakawea barotrauma descender rule stays.
ANS regs tightened — transport of live fish prohibited.

major5: 2025: ANS enforcement — drain + remove vegetation before leaving
2024: Darkhouse spearing lakes list updated
REMOVED: No live baitfish transport — removed as legal option (now prohibited)
species.unitNotes: Paddlefish snagging May 1-21 by tag only (Missouri/Yellowstone). Tag must be reported.

proclamation.highlight: <mark>Year-round. 2 lines open, 4 ice. Drain plug out + no live bait transport.</mark>
proclamation.removed: REMOVED: Live bait transport — now illegal.

species.trashTalk: Fish don't measure height — Alec's favorite even playing field.

resident: General + fishing lic — 2 lines open water, 4 ice (tip-ups)
Walleye 5/10 statewide but Devils/Sakakawea have special regs — check lake
Drain + dry + no live bait transport — ANS rule, not suggestion
Paddlefish May 1-21 tag lottery — snag, tag, report
nonresident: 3-day/10-day nonres fishing — darkhouse spearing Dec 1-Mar 15 included
Same ANS drain rule — they check at ramps
Barotrauma descender needed >30ft on Sakakawea — they enforce

species.name: Elk
species.resident: Resident lottery. E1E/E2/E1W Oct 2-Jan 3. E3/E4 Sep 4-Jan 3. 75% resident split.
species.nonresident: Nonres elk by lottery, limited (E units). Same dates, preference to residents.

briefing.bag: 1 elk per lifetime bull tag. Antlerless separate.
briefing.gear: Centerfire ≥.22, muzzy ≥.45, archery same as deer. CWD head rule applies.
briefing.unchanged: Lottery Mar 25, split season windows stable.

yoy3.change: E3/E4 Sep 4-Jan 3, E1E/E2 Oct 2-Jan 3 finalized Mar 25.

major5: 2026: quota flat 2024-26, lottery deadline Mar 25 final

proclamation.highlight: <mark>Lottery Mar 25. Unit windows Sep 4 vs Oct 2.</mark>

species.trashTalk: Elk are tall. Alec is enthusiastic. Both require patience and good glass.

resident: Lottery Mar 25 deadline — don't miss it
Once-in-a-lifetime bull tag — don't waste on a spike if you can hold
E units Badlands/Killdeer — Sep 4 vs Oct 2 windows by unit
75% resident quota — odds better than nonres
nonresident: Very limited nonres elk — same Mar 25, same windows
Nonres draw odds brutal — bring preference points and patience

species.name: Moose
species.nonresident: Very limited nonres moose (if any) — check lottery.
major5: Once-in-a-lifetime framework unchanged 5yr
species.unitNotes: Moose units NE ND. CWD not required but head submission encouraged.
species.trashTalk: Moose are basically Alec's spirit animal — big, quiet, loves the willows.

Sep 4 – Jan 3 windows, unit M1-M5

nonresident: Moose nonres tags almost mythical — check lottery for any

species.resident: Bow Sep 4-27 any pronghorn. Gun by lottery Oct 2-11.

categories.label: Non-Game / Fur
categories.blurb: Coyote to mountain lion — year-rounders and the rest.
